title: Commvault explores sale after takeover interest, Thoma Bravo among suitors
summary: Data-protection software maker Commvault (market cap about $3.5bn) is exploring a sale with Goldman Sachs after inbound interest from private equity and strategic buyers; Thoma Bravo is among those interested (Reuters). No signed deal found since.

title: EQT Secures 94% Stake in Douzone Bizon, Initiates Delisting Process
summary: EQT, via its BPEA SPV, reached 94% of Korean ERP software maker Douzone Bizon after a second tender offer at KRW 120,000 a share and began the delisting process; first tender had taken it to about 90%.

title: Ping An Seeks to Sell $1 Billion Software-Focused PE Assets
summary: Chinese insurer Ping An hired Campbell Lutyens to sell about $1bn of private equity fund stakes, mostly in two late-2010s Vista Equity software funds plus a KKR North America fund, in a secondary process that began in March.
